channels.name: log_chl
channels.unit: log10(mg m-3) — the base-10 LOGARITHM of chlorophyll-a, not the concentration

dataset: ESA OC-CCI v6.0 merged L3S daily 4 km geographic (v6.0-release)

grid.coordinates: lon = x0 + (col + 0.5) * dx, lat = y0 + (row + 0.5) * dy with dy NEGATIVE; x0/y0 are the grid's WEST and NORTH edges, and the source's `lat`/`lon` are the pixel CENTRES those edges imply
grid.extent_note: [west, south, east, north] in degrees; ocean only
grid.no_tile_corners: a plain geographic grid: the affine rule above IS the lat/lon of every pixel and every tile corner, so no corner table is stored
grid.row_order: row 0 is the NORTHERNMOST row (the source netCDF's DESCENDING `lat` axis, 89.97917 .. -89.97917, checked on the real 2015-01-15 files); col 0 is the westernmost, lon -179.97917
grid.source_variables: chlor_a (float32 mg m-3, stored as log10), kd_490 (float32 m-1) and total_nobs (float32), with the netCDF default float fill over land, cloud, night and ice

ledger_says: family1gf.tex: '1997-09-04 -> 2026-06-30, quarterly updates'. MEASURED HERE: the daily record of v6.0-release ends 2022-12-31
qc_policy: the only per-pixel flag in these two products is the fill value: chlor_a, kd_490 and total_nobs all carry netCDF's default float fill (9.96921e36) over land, cloud, night and ice, and that becomes NaN. A chlorophyll at or below 1e-4 mg m-3 is NaN too, because log10 of it is not a measurement, and it is counted (`chl_below_floor`). A value outside its channel's bounds becomes NaN and is counted (`out_of_bounds`), never clipped. The source's own per-pixel uncertainties (chlor_a_log10_bias / _rmsd, kd_490_bias / _rmsd) and the six per-sensor nobs fields are in the same files and are NOT stored: they are phase B, with the Rrs bands
